en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a mountain village nestled in the Alps. In the foreground are tall conifer trees framing several multi‑story alpine buildings with red and brown roofs. A church with a pointed bell tower stands to the right. Behind the settlement rise steep, forested mountains. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, with handwritten cursive text overlaying the lower margin.
